GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.8 (6 August 46) CIE
(SCAPIN-1106)
APO 500
6 August 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Suspension of Japanese Educators.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government, on receipt of this Memorandum, will suspend the following-named personnel from their educational positions, and will prohibit their future employment in any educational or governmental institution or agency until such time as they have been screened in compliance with SCAP Memorandum AG 350 (30 Oct 45)CIE, Subject: "Investigation, Screening, and Certification of Teachers and Educational Officials":
a. FUJITA, Sutsuya, Principal, Asahigawa Prefectural Middle School, Asahigawa, Hokkaido, Japan.
b. KOBAYASHI, Shigeo, teacher, Koriyama Technical and Commercial School, Koriyama-Shi, Fukushima-Ken, Japan.
c. SAITO, Yuko, teacher, Noshiro Industrial School, Akita Prefecture.
d. KOMATSU, Yudo, Professor, Nippon University, Tokyo.
e. KUWABARA, Susumu, Professor of Economics, Hikone Economics College, Hikone-Shi, Shiga-Ken.
f. UEDA, Norio, Head Teacher, Momoyama School, Goryo-Chi, Kyoto-Fu.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will make a report to General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, such report to include results of the screening and action taken in the case of each individual.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
